primary.name: Electric Chartreuse / Lime
primary.usage: Primary brand accent, main action buttons, highlight elements, light mode background
primary.note: Never pair with white text — fails contrast (1.18:1). Always use dark text.

secondary.name: Deep Forest Green
secondary.usage: Dark mode background, primary text on light background, headers

accent.name: Vibrant Lime Green
accent.usage: Gradients, secondary highlights, success badges, status indicators

neutral_dark.name: Dark Slate / Charcoal
neutral_dark.usage: Card backgrounds, dark theme elements, primary body text in light mode

neutral_light.name: Warm Cream / Off-White
neutral_light.usage: Light theme background, card containers, subtle section fills

soft_accent.name: Soft Lilac
soft_accent.usage: Secondary tag background, subtle contrast accents, notification chips

semantic_colors.note: Not part of the original Gemini-generated palette. Derived to match the lime/forest/cream brand family and cover procurement approval states, sample errors, and stock alerts.

success.usage: Approved orders, successful checkout, positive status badges

warning.name: Warm Amber
warning.usage: Pending review, low stock alerts, non-blocking issues

danger.name: Deep Red
danger.usage: Rejected orders, errors, destructive actions (delete sample)
